name: Orbit
description: Orbit was a community-intelligence platform for combining member and activity signals from services such as Discord, Slack, and GitHub. Postman acquired Orbit in 2024 and sunset the standalone product.
agentUseSummary: Orbit cannot be connected or installed because Postman sunset the standalone product in 2024 and no supported Orbit service or API remains available.

blocked.label: Connect Orbit
blocked.description: Standalone Orbit accounts and applications no longer operate.

blocked.label: Use Orbit API
blocked.description: The former Orbit API is not an operable supported provider surface.

blocked.label: Import Orbit data
blocked.description: Relay cannot retrieve data from the discontinued provider; a customer-held historical export must be handled as a separate local-file workflow.

blocked.label: Substitute Postman APIs
blocked.description: Postman's current platform is a separate provider contract and is not presented as a continuation of the retired Orbit API.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No actions can be enabled for a discontinued provider.

runtimeSupport.description: No supported Orbit service or API remains available to mount.
No supported Orbit service or API remains available to mount.

providerSetup.blocker: Postman announced on April 11, 2024 that the current Orbit product would sunset over the following 90 days. The former standalone product and API are not operable supported services in July 2026.
providerSetup.nextAction: Do not request credentials or show Connect. Keep the historical provider unavailable and reconsider only if Postman or a successor publishes an officially supported Orbit service and API.

evidence.supports: Postman's official acquisition announcement states that the current Orbit product would sunset over the next 90 days.
The official historical Orbit Postman workspace remains visible but was last described before the announced product sunset and does not establish a current supported service.
The former product origin returns a Cloudflare 530 response rather than an operable Orbit application.
The former documentation origin redirects through the retired API/product domains and does not expose a current supported API contract.
